structured_output.summary: The change implements Array.prototype.at against the five spec steps, in order. ToObject(this) and LengthOfArrayLike run before the index is converted, as the spec requires. The ToAbsoluteIndex logic is a local helper in the same file: ToIntegerOrInfinity, then length + int when int is finite and negative. The out-of-range check (k < 0 or k >= length) returns undefined, and the final read is ops::get with the key from k. Every fallible step uses `?`, nothing is defaulted or swallowed, and there are no test-shaped branches. The only unimplemented path is BigInt, which surfaces through the engine's own not-implemented error, so it is honest partial work. The local helper is permitted by the ticket and is reported in the file's doc comment. Renaming new_target to _new_target is needed because the parameter is no longer used.
